name: Annotated Price Chart
when_to_pick: Show a worked trade setup on a real-looking price chart: a price series (line or candlesticks) overlaid with annotation lines and zones — an entry level, a stop-loss line or zone (red/sell), a take-profit line or zone (green/buy), plus optional support/resistance levels and free-floating text callouts pinned to a candle. Pick it when you are walking the reader through a specific setup (a breakout long, a range fade, a pullback entry) and you want them to SEE where entry, risk and reward sit relative to structure — not just read numbers in a table. Static, dependency-free inline SVG: it renders the full chart on first paint with no chart library and no blank frame. Use the risk_reward_visualizer instead when you only need the proportional entry/SL/TP ladder without price action; use a Chart.js line/area chart when the point is the data trend itself rather than an annotated setup.

title.description: Heading above the chart, e.g. 'EUR/USD — breakout long above range high'.

instrument.description: Instrument symbol shown in the header chip (display only), e.g. 'EUR/USD', 'BTC/USDT'.

timeframe.description: Timeframe label shown in the header chip (display only), e.g. '4H', 'Daily', '15m'.

chart_type.description: Render the series as a single price line/area ('line') or as OHLC candlesticks ('candles'). When 'candles', each series item must be an OHLC object; when 'line', each item is a number (close) — or an OHLC object whose close is used.

series.description: The price series, oldest first. For chart_type 'line' use plain numbers (closes). For 'candles' use OHLC objects.

decimals.description: Price precision for level labels (4 for FX majors, 2 for indices/stocks, 0–2 for crypto large caps).

levels.description: Horizontal annotation lines drawn across the chart at a price. Order does not matter; they are positioned by price.

price.description: Price at which the horizontal line sits. Should fall within (or near) the series' min/max for best framing.

label.description: Short label for the line's pill, e.g. 'Entry', 'Stop-loss', 'Take-profit', 'Range high (R)'.

tone.description: Semantic styling: 'entry' (accent), 'stop' (red/sell), 'target' (green/buy), 'support'/'resistance' (neutral structural lines), 'neutral' (muted). Drives color, not position.

side.description: Which end of the line the price pill is anchored to, to avoid overlapping pills.

zones.description: Optional shaded horizontal price bands (a region between two prices), e.g. the risk band entry→stop or the reward band entry→target.

from.description: One edge price of the band.

to.description: The other edge price of the band.

tone.description: 'risk' shades red (entry→stop), 'reward' shades green (entry→target), 'neutral' shades muted.

label.description: Optional tag shown inside the band, e.g. 'Risk', 'Reward'.

callouts.description: Optional free-floating text labels pinned to a specific candle/point index, e.g. marking the breakout candle.

index.description: 0-based index into 'series' the callout points at.

text.description: Short callout text, e.g. 'Breakout candle', 'Pullback fills'.

anchor.description: Place the callout above or below the candle/point.

tone.description: Marker dot + connector color for the callout.

legend.description: Show the compact legend row (entry / stop / target swatches) under the chart when corresponding levels exist.

caption.description: Optional one-line takeaway shown under the chart (plain text).
